name: smwmusic-sonic-forces-sunset-heights-arrangement
title: Sonic Forces - Sunset Heights (Arrangement)
description:
This is an arrangement of Sunset Heights from Sonic Forces. Mostly used samples from different SNES games for this one, along with a few custom samples here and there so I could get a good enough feel for this. I'm still not too satisfied with the overdriven guitar choice (mostly since I couldn't find a better suited one for this song, and I didn't want to do another port with the MMX1 overdriven guitar, so), but other than that, I think it's fine.

Anyway, use this if you need some kind of a "tables have turned on your favor" situation, like when a final boss is kicking your ass, and then you somehow get enough power to defeat it, and you KNOW you can't fail everyone or else the world will be destroyed kinda situation; I know, hella specific, but still
